definitions.explanation: The bony framework of a human or animal body. In everyday usage, often refers to a skeleton model or a skull-and-crossbones image.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理科室|りかしつ}→理科室：22704_rikashitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{骸骨|がいこつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a skeleton model in the science room.

examples.japanese: ⟦ハロウィン→ハロウィン：27505_harowin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{骸骨|がいこつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used skeletons as Halloween decorations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洞窟|どうくつ}→洞窟：05038_doukutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{骸骨|がいこつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An old skeleton was discovered deep inside the cave.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both real skeletons and decorative/symbolic ones. The skull-and-crossbones symbol (pirate flag, poison warning) is also called {骸骨|がいこつ}⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {骸骨|がいこつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧ (skeleton model)
- {骸骨|がいこつ}⟦マーク→マーク：09478_maaku⟧ (skull-and-crossbones symbol)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{骨格|こっかく}→骨格：06233_kokkaku⟧: skeletal frame — more technical/anatomical
- {頭蓋骨|ずがいこつ}: skull — specifically the skull
